english.title: Possess medicinal product for supply without authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had in your possession a relevant medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY..), knowing or having reasonable cause to believe that the product

(A)_[was placed on the market]_
(B)_[was intended to be placed on the market]_

without holding a Community or United Kingdom marketing authorisation in respect of that product
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 2 and 14 of Schedule 3 to the Medicines for Human Use (Marketing Authorisations etc) Regulations 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
possess a relevant medicinal product
knowing/having reasonable cause to believe
the product was/intended to be placed on the market
without Community/UK marketing authorisation

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence relates to prescribed drugs which are NOT CONTROLLED by the the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
(ii) See offence wording H3620 for supplying etc a relevant medicinal product knowing etc that it was/intended to place it on the market without relevant marketing authorisation.
(iii) The Medicines Control Agency (MCA) is responsible for the enforcement of medicines legislation in the United Kingdom. The MCA is an executive agency of the Department of Health whose primary objective is to safeguard public health by ensuring that all medicines on the UK market meet appropriate standards safety, quality and efficacy. The MCA have an intelligence unit Tel 0207 2730617 and will assist with queries.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
